SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_548A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7Much more of this and we'll lose that engine!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_549A_LAND.en: ^1LANDRY: ^7We have a hull breach right above me!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_570A_USR3.en:
^1US SEAMAN: ^7Get me outta here!
Please god, get me out of here!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_577A_USR1.en:
^1US SEAMAN: ^7There's more coming,
get me outta the fucking water, get me out!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_577A_USR1_SAFE.en:
^1US SEAMAN: ^7There's more coming,
get me outta the water, get me out!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_580A_USR1.en: ^1US SEAMAN: ^7Oh god, oh my god, oh god, (whining)

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_602A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7You put a lotta holes in that PT Boat.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_605A_LAUG.en: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7You tore that PT boat to pieces!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_631A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Let's hope there's enough left on the front!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_001A_BOOT.en: ^1BOOTH: ^7Yeah... I see 'em... Landry, open up comms.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_002A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Major Gordon...
Vessels are now in visual range.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_004A_MAJG.en:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7They're probably re-supplying
the enemy on Okinawa.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_006A_MAJG.en:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Affirmative.
They're part of the enemy war machine.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_007A_MAJG.en: ^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Permission to engage.  Over and out.

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_009A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Laughlin, Locke! Get to your stations!
Start picking targets!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_010A_BOOT.en:
^1BOOTH: ^7Locke!  Get you thumb out your ass
and pull that damn trigger!!!

SUBTITLE_PBY1_OUT_006A_CAIR.en:
^1CORSAIR PILOT: ^7Black Cat Mantaray 54.
Havok 26, coming over you now.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_100A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Our Tanks are getting hammered
by mortar fire!

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_101A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're need to clear these trenches
and knock out each mortar pit!

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_106A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Throw some smoke for cover!
Or it will rip us to shreds!

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_120A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Taken out. One more pit to clear.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_122A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Take cover!
Behind the barrels, get down!

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_126A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get in there and clear those tunnels!

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_129A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Radio command, tell 'em
we've cleared the mortar pits.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_131A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Sir, mortar pits have 
been neutralized... Tanks are now 
en route to the point.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_133A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7We have confirmed
sightings of Japanese reinforcements on the move.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_139A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7They'll be right on us
within six hours.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_140A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7They'll be right on us
within four hours.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_141A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7They'll be right on us
within two hours.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_144A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They recapture these trenches,
and we're right back to square one.

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_149A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I don't care if the emperor's
damn picture's on it!

SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_149A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I don't care if the emperor's
picture's on it!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_000A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7The 200mm on the point
still has white beach targeted.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_001A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We all saw first hand what that
means when he hit shore.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_002A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Any attempt to bring in reinforcements
just leads to the same outcome...

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_004A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Yeah... well...  
Major Gordon's suspended any further landings
until the guns are knocked out.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_006A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Tojo's got a network of tunnels and caves
running through the whole damn rock...

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_006A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Tojo's got a network of tunnels and caves
running through the whole rock...

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_007A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're trying to flush 'em out with the dogs...
but we all know how stubborn these bastards are.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_007A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're trying to flush 'em out with the dogs...
but we all know how stubborn these animals are.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_009A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7They'll come at us from all sides.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_013A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Find some cover, fast! GO GO GO!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_017A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7We got artillery coming from the northeast!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_018A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We need to move up and knock 'em out!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_026A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Clear it out! So our tanks can move up!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_029A_USR1.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Get your damn hands off me!!!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_037A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Our tanks should be able to provide
some cover as we close in around the hill.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_038A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7But it'll be up to us to clear the caves...

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_040A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Dammit!  Do the airforce know we're here?!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_041A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay in cover till they finish their run!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_045A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay with the tank!  Use it for cover!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_046A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Watch the fire!... Stay behind the tank!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_047A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Polonsky, take the one on the right!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_048A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Polonsky, take the one on the left!

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_002B_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7How many Marines did we lose
taking this rock?

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_004A_ROOK.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7Relay the message to Major Gordon.
The artillery on the point has been knocked out.
Yes sir.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_009A_PFOR.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Hey, Grigson.  How you doin' on ammo?

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_010A_PGRI.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7Just swell... 
So long as they don't expect me to shoot anyone else.

SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_011A_PFOR.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7What good is all that ammo
doin' sitting back at command?

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_000A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Get off the beach the beach!
MOVE!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_003A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Don't let 'em get a fix on you...

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_018A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Pick it up...
Push through their lines!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_042A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7They were hiding, just waiting for us...

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_044A_ROEB_B.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7From here on out, watch the terrain.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_048A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Get in there...
See if you can get a flanking position.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_050A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Let's get the jump on these bastards.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_050A_ROEB_SAFE.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Let's get the jump on these animals.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_061A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Get on those MG's
and tear them up!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_100A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7We got heavy MG fire tearing up the beach!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_101A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Call in rocket strikes
on those positions! NOW!!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_106A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7We need rockets on those MG's ASAP!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_107A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7We're gettin' torn
to shreds here! CALL THOSE ROCKETS!!!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_201A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Where are you going?
We need those rockets!!!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_203A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Good work, Marines...
Regroup at the treeline!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_206A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Just get moving!
We'll deal with it later!!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_210A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Miller!!  Call a rocket strike
on that MG nest!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_300A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7I got you Miller! You're still in one piece!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_301A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Plan's gone to shit... Tojo's got a defensive line dug in just beyond the treeline.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_302A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Stay where you are and get ready with that radio.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_304A_USR1.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7There wasn't supposed
to be any resistance!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_307A_USR3.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7I think his LVT got hit!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_311A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7That rocket strike should
have softened them up.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_315A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7We need to wipe those
bastards out!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_316A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I don't think that MG's
gonna cut it, Miller!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_800A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Barrage -salvo H-E, 
Waco two-five, azimuth 3320, range 2200...
Firing for effect - on the way!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_803A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Salvo barrage, 
Waco two-five effective... target destroyed. 
Check your fire.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_804A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Target miss... 
Diligent one-six adjust your fire!
Repeat, adjust your fire!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_805A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Barrage-salvo H-E, 
Waco eight-one, Azimuth 35, 
Range 28... on the way!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_806A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Airedale Three has your smoke
at Bravo Lima six actual... Ironclad firing for effect... 
On the way!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_807A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Your flare spotted
at grid Able Delta five-niner.
H-E salvo close, in-bound now!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_808A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Adjusting fire your target
Azimuth 33, range 29... H-E salvo close... 
On the way!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_809A_RADO.en: ^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Registering your target Azimuth 33, range 29... H-E salvo close... on the way!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_814A_RADO.en: ^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Fire mission unavailable at this time.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_829A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Fire support ready.
State your target.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_833A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Off shore rocket
strike at the ready.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_834A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Rocket strike primed
and ready to fire.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_837A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Airstrike primed
and ready to fire.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_844A_RADO.en:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Negative on those
co-ordinates. Check your status.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_003A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Navy's been bombin' hell out of the island for two days straight.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_003A_SULL_SAFE.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Navy's been bombin' the island for two days straight.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_004A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Okay... Keep it together and we'll
get through this in three days.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_007A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Miller! We hit any resistance
on the beach,  you get on that radio and call
for immediate missile support!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_008A_SULL.en:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Roebuck, I want you up the beach
and at the treeline asap. 
You're on point as we move inland.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_011A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7FUCK! East ridge! There's a 200mm on the point!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_011A_ROEB_SAFE.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7East ridge!... There's a 200mm on the point!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_017A_POLO.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7We need to get off this thing!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_019A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Driver, drop the ramp!  That gun could zero in on us anytime.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_020A_PSOU.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7It's the coral.  We're stuck on the...

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_102A_SULL.en: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Everyone!  Keep... your... heads... down!  You hear me?

SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_103A_USR2.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7The Lord is my Shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: He leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul: He leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for His name' sake. Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: For thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me. Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; Thou annointest my head with oil; My cup runneth over. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the House of the Lord forever.

SUBTITLE_PEL1_OUT_202A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan! No... Hold on...
You'll be okay... CORPSMAN!!!

SUBTITLE_PEL1_OUT_202B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan! No... Hold on...
You'll be okay... MEDIC!!!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_001B_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Direct route runs right into Japanese guns.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_003B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We take the flank.
It might get us wet, but it's not going to get us killed. 
We regroup with the 5th when we're through this swamp.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_005A_PGRI.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7SARGE! We got a downed Corsair.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_006A_POLO_A.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Poor bastard must have been
shot down this morning.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_006A_POLO_SAFE.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7He must have been shot down
this morning.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_007A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, fuselage is still smoking...
Check for survivors.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_007B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Fuselage is still smoking...
Check for survivors.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_008A_PGRI.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7He's all snarled up on something...

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_014A_POLO_A.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Can't believe they'd booby trap our dead...

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_017A_POLO_C.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7I think we're kinda late.
Sounds like the 5th's kicking ass.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_017A_POLO_SAFE.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7I think we're kinda late.
Sounds like the 5th's already fighting!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_018A_ROEB_A.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7MG's in the bunkers up ahead.
Nambu artillery sittin' right in front of it.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_029A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I want suppressing fire on those MG's!
The flamethrowers need to reach the bunkers.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_033A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Keep it together.
Airfield's about half a mile north.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_041A_PLOG.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7The 7th came in from the north!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_042A_PGAS.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7They're trying to get their tanks
on to the airfield, but it's a nightmare over there.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_043A_PLOG.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7Tojo's holding tight!
We're pinned down by the MG fire
from the second floor.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_048A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller! Load up with those
rifle grenades and blow that damn bird off his perch.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_048A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller! Load up with those
rifle grenades and blow that bird off his perch.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_054A_ROEB_A.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7One last push and we take the airfield!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_056A_ROEB_A.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7It never is... But we can do this,
Polonsky, okay?

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_060A_POLO_A.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Japanese AA Guns are zeroed
on our planes!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_061A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We'll get to them!...
We gotta deal with their tanks first!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_063A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Bazookas, rifle grenades!
Hit 'em with whatever you can!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_071A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Move up and take out the AA Guns!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_073A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller!  Take out the first gun crew!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_080A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get the last one,
before we lose anymore birds!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_083B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Let's give Major Gordon
the good news.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_109A_PHIL.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Guy in the tree, guy in the tree!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_112A_PHIL.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7They were just waiting for us...

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_200A_ROEB.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, get the flamethrower and finish the job!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_301A_PFOR.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7Awww shit...
Bastards just took down another one.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_301A_PFOR_SAFE.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7They just took down another one!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_302A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7All the more reason to keep pushin'.
Every plane we lose makes our job harder.
